question: In Jain Basti temple of Karnataka, over the garbhagriha is raised a ________ storied nirandhara vimana with a square griva and sikhara.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**five**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Jain Basti temple in Karnataka is known for its **distinctive architecture**.
 
• It features a **five-storied** nirandhara vimana, a unique architectural element.
 
• The term **nirandhara** refers to a type of vimana without ambulatory passage.
 
• The **vimana** is topped with a **square griva** and **sikhara**, characteristic of Jain temple architecture.
 
• The temple is an important example of the **Hoysala architectural style**, which flourished in Karnataka.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hoysala Architecture**__

 
 
• The **Hoysala dynasty** ruled over parts of present-day Karnataka from the 10th to the 14th centuries.
 
• Hoysala architecture is renowned for its **intricate carvings**, **star-shaped platforms**, and **elaborate sculptural decoration**.
 
• Some of the most famous Hoysala temples include the **Chennakesava Temple** at Belur and the **Hoysaleswara Temple** at Halebidu.
